facts.statement: JCC tournaments ran all day during Snow Days.
facts.quote: Los torneos JCC acontecerán durante todo el día.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Recordatorio de Eventos en Días de Nieve)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post reminding players of the Snow Days community event schedule, which ran daily through January 3. It explains how to find the in-game event calendar and use its Go button to teleport to an event. The post gives no year, so the exact date is unknown (relative timestamp reads '1 year, 5 months ago' at capture).
